name: SpankChain LedgerChannel reentrancy
summary: LCOpenTimeout transferred the channel's ETH and then called an attacker-controlled token before deleting the channel state, so the token's transfer callback could repeatedly re-enter LCOpenTimeout and withdraw the same ETH balance.
notes: This transaction deployed the direct LedgerChannel runtime; its statically linked ECTools library address is embedded in that runtime.

SpankChain's post-mortem reports 165.38 ETH drained (about $38,000) and about $4,000 of BOOTY immobilized. This records the loss at exploit time; the attacker's later return of funds does not reduce the incident-time amount.
